title: Windshield Assembly — Removal

issue.reason: Original issue of the windshield assembly removal task.

abstract: Removal of a windshield pane from the flight compartment aperture, including the shim measurement that must be recorded before the retaining bolts are disturbed and the handling rules for a laminated structural pane.

sections.purpose: To remove a windshield pane from the flight compartment aperture for replacement, or to gain access to the frame for inspection.
sections.job_setup_note: The aircraft must be de-powered and the windshield heating isolated at the circuit breaker before any work. The pane lifting frame must be fitted before the retaining bolts are removed. The shim stack at each retaining position must be measured and recorded first, because the replacement pane is set to the recorded values. Three persons are needed for the lift.
sections.procedure: WARNING: ISOLATE THE WINDSHIELD HEATING AT THE CIRCUIT BREAKER AND FIT THE SAFETY COLLAR BEFORE ANY WORK. THE HEATER TERMINAL CARRIES A LETHAL VOLTAGE WHEN THE SYSTEM IS LIVE. Remove the electrical power and put the warning notices in position. Isolate and collar the windshield heating circuit breaker. Remove the flight compartment side panel trim to gain access to the heater terminal. Disconnect the heater feed at the terminal and insulate the free end. Measure the shim stack at each retaining position and record every value against its position number. Fit the pane lifting frame to the outer face and tighten the suction cups. CAUTION: DO NOT FIT A SUCTION CUP OVER A DELAMINATED AREA. THE PLY CAN SEPARATE UNDER THE LIFTING LOAD. Remove the retaining bolts AES273284K7 working from the centre outwards, and keep the bolts with their position numbers. Remove the blind rivets AES757493-5D at the outboard doubler ARD967927-47 by drilling to the depth in the drawing. Break the sealant bond at the frame with the nylon wedge, working slowly around the perimeter. Lift the pane clear with three persons and put it in the transit frame with the shim record attached.
sections.close_out: Cover the aperture with the protective blank and seal it against weather. Make sure that no drill swarf remains in the frame channel or on the glareshield. Make sure that the heater feed is insulated and secured. Remove the warning notices. Record the removal, the pane serial number, the shim values by position and the condition of the frame land.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The heater terminal position differs on aircraft post MOD-111324.

safety_precautions: Isolate the windshield heating at the circuit breaker and fit the safety collar before any work.
Do not fit a suction cup over a delaminated area.
Use three persons for the lift.

tooling.description: Pane lifting frame with suction cups
